leads.name: Amy Moore
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate — executive coach, supervisor, case writer

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: Very broad reach: financial services, mining, FMCG, energy, telecoms, insurance, logistics/utilities, academic bodies.
Works across both MBA / core academic and customised corporate programmes.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: 40+ published teaching cases; GIBS case-writer-of-the-year (2022 & 2023); FT Responsible Business Education Award.
Co-authored 2025 GIBS white paper on coach supervision.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: 3,500+ coaching hours, individual & team, graduate to executive; lead coach on larger programmes.
Also facilitator, learning integrator, mentor to MBA students.

leads.name: Jacqueline (Jackie) Wilken
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate since 2012 — executive coach & facilitator; coach supervisor

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: Exceptionally broad; strong financial-services core (Absa, Barclays, Standard Bank, FNB, Nedbank, Sanlam).
Insurance/fintech, FMCG, public sector/SOEs, pharma, mining, construction, professional services, higher ed; also start-ups & NGOs.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: Corporate career: GM, group strategy, Chief of Staff to Barclays Africa; ex commercial attorney & investment banker.
Strategic thinking, stakeholder management, board development.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Executive coach/facilitator since 2012; coach supervisor; 5,000+ hours across board to middle-management.
Also: career transitions, courageous conversations, women in leadership.

leads.name: Janet Featherstone
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate since 2008 — executive coach, facilitator, programme designer

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: Clients: Anglo American, Sanlam, Vodacom, Shoprite, SETAs. 20 yrs corporate, incl. 5 yrs board-level exec.
International delivery: Saudi Arabia, US, Mozambique, Tanzania, Ghana, Zimbabwe, India, DRC, Chile, Brazil, Australia, Singapore, UK, Germany.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: Explicitly a programme designer, not just a coach/facilitator.
Founded GreatnessWorx (2008) & Coach Quest (2021); co-founded Shanti Innovations (2024).

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Exec coach, action learning coach, facilitator, lecturer, integrator, programme designer.
Level 3 Master Certified Coach (2025); WIAL action learning coach; ORSC trained.

leads.name: Jenny (Jennifer) Lorenzo
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate since 2012 — OD practitioner, team & executive coach

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: Standard Bank, Cell C, Multotec, Komatsu, Nampak, MultiChoice, Bloomberg, Aspen, SARS, FNB, SAB Miller, BP, HP.
International delivery in South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: OD grounding (MSc OD, Middlesex/Metanoia); certified in the Leadership Circle Profile.
Facilitation style: creativity, reflection, courageous dialogue; psychological safety, adaptive mindsets.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Facilitator, executive/group coach, action learning coach since 2012.
AoEC Systemic Team Coaching Certificate; GIBS Professional Business Coaching Certificate.

leads.name: Kim Rey
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate since 2011 — leadership & organisational change consultant

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: Three decades of HR/leadership dev: start-ups to multinationals and government; retail background (Morkels/Moresport).
International delivery: Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Egypt, Mauritius, Eswatini, Middle East, UK, USA, Spain, Hungary, Hong Kong, Brazil.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: Runs own consultancy (Kim Rey and Associates, est. 2001): leadership dev, OD change management, strategic HR.
Leads change transition programmes, large and small scale.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Personal development & action learning coach, lecturer, integrator.
ICF & WIAL member; individual and team coaching; remote/virtual-ready.

leads.name: Lanier Covington
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate since 2007 — facilitator & learning integrator

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: Mining, financial services, construction, telecommunications, energy — all organisational levels.
International delivery: US, Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, Malaysia, Dubai, India. Founded Covington Consulting (2003).

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: Generalist consulting & training design for corporates and individuals.
Personal effectiveness, leadership/management development, change management, team/org effectiveness.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Facilitator, Learning Integrator, Personal Development Coach, Action Learning Coach.
Certified NLP Practitioner & Master Practitioner (INLPTA); WIAL Action Learning Coach.

leads.name: Laura Malan
leads.tagline: GIBS part-time faculty since 2003, Associate since 2011 — coach, facilitator, programme director

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: Extremely broad: 6 continents, 40+ countries — advertising, education, engineering, financial services, ICT, legal, non-profit, public sector, mining, FMCG, pharma, telecoms, UN System.
Pre-OD background in software product R&D and IT/video-comms business management.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: Designer & lead faculty of GIBS "Leader as Mentor"; heads the GIBS Facilitation Special Interest Group.
Integrated, multi-disciplinary approach aimed at systemic, transformational change.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Full spectrum: lecturer, speaker, designer, facilitator, lead coach, executive/group coach, integrator.
4,000+ coaching hours since 2002; SACAP coach supervisor; Time to Think, ORSC, Leadership Embodiment, Deep Democracy.

leads.name: Tammy (Tamarra) Perrie
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate since 2006 — coach, mentor coach, learning integrator

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: 22 yrs retail/corporate/merchant banking leadership (Standard Bank, ABN Amro, ABSA, Rabobank Intl), then MD at a healthcare diagnostics company.
Coaching/consulting since 2005; consults for the Oxford Group (London); sits on corporate coaching panels.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: Postgraduate Diploma in Design Thinking & Innovation (Emeritus); heads the GIBS Action Learning Special Interest Group.
Builds bespoke learning solutions for her own client portfolio.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Coach, mentor coach, action learning coach, learning integrator, facilitator across GIBS Custom Programmes.
PCC-accredited (ICF); Accredited Multipliers Coach (BRG/Wiseman Group).

leads.name: Vezinhlahla (Vezi) Mncwango
leads.tagline: GIBS Professional Associate — executive, leadership & action learning coach

sections.label: Sector experience
bullets: 15 yrs Accounting & Auditing at senior/executive level, incl. Senior Manager at the Auditor-General of South Africa.
Last 10 yrs in leadership, executive & team coaching; projects across Africa, Middle East, Europe.

sections.label: Design strengths
bullets: Design lens rooted in intra-personal transformation and leadership identity.
NLP-based and Theory-U methodology.

sections.label: Modality experience
bullets: Executive, Action Learning, Integration, and Leadership Coaching at GIBS.
Certified Master NLP Coach & Business Coach; Lumina Practitioner; Theory-U practitioner.
